description: This is a test class for the DatatableExportUtil utility class in the Fineract project. It contains unit tests for methods related to normalizing folder names and generating export file names with specific naming conventions and validations.

classes.name: DatatableExportUtilTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DatatableExportUtil which verifies the correctness of folder name normalization and export filename generation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting a tenant context before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment by resetting the tenant context after each test.

methods.name: emptyFolderTest
methods.description: Tests normalization of empty or null folder names.

methods.name: specialCharacterFolderTest
methods.description: Tests normalization of folder names with special characters.

methods.name: normalizedFolderNameTest
methods.description: Tests normalization of typical folder names, including nested paths and redundant slashes.

methods.name: generateDatatableExportFileNameSuccessTest
methods.description: Verifies that a valid filename is generated matching expected pattern with given parameters.

methods.name: generateDatatableExportFileNameComplexTest
methods.description: Tests filename generation with complex folder structures, validation failures for length and extension, and presence of report parameters.
